output_list.reason: The mintToken function allows the owner to arbitrarily create new tokens and assign them to any user account, including accounts that may not have participated in a crowdsale or otherwise earned the tokens. This can lead to a loss of investment for token buyers and a negative impact on the token's market value.
The transfer function does not check for integer overflow, allowing a user to transfer more tokens than they have, which can effectively freeze token balance of the user.
The transferFrom function does not check for integer overflow, allowing a user to transfer more tokens from an account than are available, which can effectively freeze token balance of the user.
The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing users to buy an unintended amount of tokens, potentially draining the contract of funds.
The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability, allowing users to sell an unintended amount of tokens, potentially draining the contract of funds.
